findings.title: [P1] Restore the tenant boundary check
findings.body: Returning true unconditionally allows a user from any tenant to read documents belonging to every other tenant, creating a direct cross-tenant authorization bypass and potential data disclosure.

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant ownership check
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: Current src/access.ts still returns true unconditionally at line 2. The full PR diff shows the tenant equality check was replaced by `return true`; the later label-only change in src/labels.ts does not restore authorization.
